newsitem.title: DENMARK: Moeller sells Thai oil operation.
newsitem.headline: Moeller sells Thai oil operation.

text.p: Danish shipping and oil group A.P. Moeller said on Wednesday that its Maersk Oil (Thailand) Ltd unit had sold its Thai oil prospecting activities to Rutherford-Moran Oil Corporation.
Maersk began reducing its activities in Thailand in 1995 and started preparing the sale in November 1996, a Moeller spokesman told Reuters.

Moeller said Rutherford-Moran, an independent energy company operating primarily in southeast Asia, paid $28.6 million for Maersk Oil's 31.67 percent stake in a Gulf of Thailand offshore oil area in the deal.
It said the sale meant that Maersk Oil was now no longer engaged in oil activities in the Gulf of Thailand.
